description: This file defines a class Opportunities within the Step\Acceptance namespace. The class extends AcceptanceTester and provides a method createOpportunity() that automates the creation of an opportunity in a CRM system using test steps, including filling fields, selecting options, and verifying the UI elements.

classes.name: Opportunities
classes.description: A test support class for automating the creation of opportunities in the CRM during acceptance tests.

methods.name: createOpportunity
methods.description: Automates the process of creating an opportunity by interacting with the UI elements, filling in fields with provided data, and verifying UI states.
